name: cable reverse grip pulldown
description: Pull a bar down to your chest with an underhand grip. It works the lats and gets the biceps more involved.
instructions: Sit at a pulldown station with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and together.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
